name: Act Security
description: Act Security is the action-first cloud security platform built to secure the cloud at its foundation. Rather than just surfacing findings, Act eliminates the conditions that make risk exploitable in the first place. By analyzing both network and identity layers in a single access graph, Act enforces precise boundaries for humans, workloads, and AI agents across multi-cloud infrastructure. Grounded in real business context and enforced through cloud-native controls, Act helps organizations eliminate attack paths, safely scale AI, and maintain continuous, audit-ready compliance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Act Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Act Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.act.security/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Act Security MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Act Security provides these MCP tools: act_check_access, act_get_access_path_detail, act_get_access_paths, act_get_schema, act_get_service_perimeters, act_get_vertex, act_list_perimeter_services, act_list_perimeters, act_list_reachable_services, act_list_service_edges, and act_search_vertices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Act Security?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Act Security in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Act Security MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Act Security requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Act Security is developed by Act Security Inc. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
